text:
In 2011 international (PPP) dollars, U.S. GDP per capita in 1850 was about $2,825, the Maddison Project Database figure for that year. That is roughly $7.70 per person per day; compounding it forward at the long-run real growth rate of about 1.8% a year reaches about $50,000 by 2011. Later Maddison vintages and the U.S. GDP deflator can move that point estimate by a few hundred dollars.
